finding: xG and xGOT (home_xg/away_xg/home_xgot/away_xgot on fixtures.stats, and xg_total/xg_for/xg_against on team-stats endpoints) are NOT populated for the full historical window claimed in the original DATA_AUDIT.md. There is a platform-wide data-vendor cutover somewhere between 2024-02-11 and 2024-05-02, before which xG fields are null across every league tested, and after which they are consistently populated.
method: Live GET /api/fixtures/between?include=stats calls at four bracketing time points, cross-checked across 3 of the 5 target leagues to rule out a league-specific gap.
conclusion: xG/xGOT should be treated as reliably available from approximately Q1/Q2 2024 onward (exact date not yet pinned down beyond the Feb 11 - May 2 2024 bracket), not from 2020/21 as the raw season-list endpoint would suggest. All other match stats fields tested (possession, cards, corners, fouls, shots, shots_on, tackles, offsides, goal_kicks, throw_ins, has_odds) were populated as far back as August 2023, the earliest point tested.
recommendation: Before finalizing the historical training window for any xG-based feature, run a short bisection script against fixtures/between to pin the exact cutover date/matchday per league. Do not assume it is identical across all 5 leagues without checking the remaining two (La Liga, Serie A) the same way.
